name: productive-mcp
description: Access Productive.io data: projects, folders, tasks, pages, comments, todos, people, workflow statuses, and time entries.
long_description: An MCP server that provides tools to interact with the Productive.io API. Supports searching across projects/tasks/pages/actions, listing and managing tasks, comments, todos, time entries, pages, attachments, folders, workflow statuses, and team members. Includes read-only mode for safety and Hybrid/TOON/JSON output format options.

tools.name: quick_search
tools.description: Search across projects, tasks, pages, and actions

tools.name: list_recent_activity
tools.description: Get summarized feed of recent activities and updates

tools.name: list_workflow_statuses
tools.description: List workflow statuses with optional filters

tools.name: list_time_entries
tools.description: List time entries with optional date/relationship filters

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: List tasks with optional filtering and pagination

tools.name: get_task
tools.description: Get detailed task information by ID

tools.name: get_task_history
tools.description: Get comprehensive task history including status changes, assignments, and milestones

tools.name: list_comments
tools.description: List comments with optional filtering by project or task

tools.name: list_todos
tools.description: List todo checklist items with optional filtering

tools.name: get_todo
tools.description: Get specific todo checklist item by ID

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Get specific page/document by ID with full content

tools.name: get_person
tools.description: Get detailed info about a specific team member by ID

tools.name: list_attachments
tools.description: List attachment/file metadata with optional filtering

api_key.title: API Key
api_key.description: Your Productive API key (from Productive Settings > API Access)

organization.title: Organization ID
organization.description: Your Productive organization ID (found in the browser URL when logged in)

output_format.title: Output Format
output_format.description: Output format for tool results: 'hybrid' (TOON text + JSON structured data), 'toon' (compact, LLM-optimized), or 'json' (standard)

read_only.title: Read-Only Mode
read_only.description: When enabled, write operations (create/update/delete) are blocked
